Established on 1 April 1888, Sparta Rotterdam is the oldest professional [[Association football|football]] team in the Netherlands. Sparta currently competes in the [[Eredivisie]], the [[Dutch football league system|top flight]] of [[Football in the Netherlands|Dutch professional football]], which they have won six times, having earned promotion from the [[Eerste Divisie]] in [[2018–19 Eerste Divisie|2018–19]]. The club is one of three professional football clubs from Rotterdam, the others being [[Excelsior Rotterdam|Excelsior]] (est. 1902) and [[Feyenoord]] (est. 1908)."}}
